name: Amazon SP-API
label: Amazon Selling Partner API — Orders 2026-01-01, Catalog, Feeds, Reports
description: SP-API regional host sellingpartnerapi-{region}.amazon.com (config region: na | eu | fe). Header x-amz-access-token is a Login-with-Amazon access token (refresh out of band). IAM/SigV4 not required since 2023-10-02. Orders path 2026-01-01 is searchOrders/getOrder (v0 getOrders PascalCase query names retired; use marketplaceIds, createdAfter, fulfillmentStatuses). Catalog 2022-04-01, Feeds/Reports 2021-06-30, FBA Inventory v1 current. No Seller Central scrape. Notifications are SQS/EventBridge — trigger is ingress after the operator bridges. Docs: https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/orders-api-migration-guide Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_list | order_get | catalog_get | inventory_get | feed_create | report_get | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: marketplaceIds
schema.description: Query-string parameter `marketplaceIds` for operations: order_list, catalog_get, inventory_get.

schema.label: includedData
schema.description: Query-string parameter `includedData` for operations: order_list, catalog_get.

schema.label: orderId
schema.description: URL path parameter `orderId` for operation: order_get. Required by: order_get.

schema.label: asin
schema.description: URL path parameter `asin` for operation: catalog_get. Required by: catalog_get.

schema.label: reportId
schema.description: URL path parameter `reportId` for operation: report_get. Required by: report_get.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_list | order_get | catalog_get | inventory_get | feed_create | report_get | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Login-with-Amazon access token minted outside StudioQuack (header x-amz-access-token). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: SP-API regional endpoint the seller account and marketplaces belong to. EXACT: na | eu | fe. na = sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com (US, CA, MX, BR), eu = sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, IN, AE, ...), fe = sellingpartnerapi-fe.amazon.com (JP, AU, SG). Example: eu for marketplace A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE). Substituted into baseUrl https://sellingpartnerapi-{region}.amazon.com; blank uses na.

configurationParameters.label: Marketplace Ids
configurationParameters.description: Default marketplaceIds query (e.g. ATVPDKIKX0DER) when INPUT omits it. Orders 2026-01-01, Catalog 2022-04-01, and FBA Inventory v1.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
